nativeFindings: Selection toggles update selectedCalendarIDs, not record deletion.
Selection observer persists selection, saves widget selection and schedules notifications/Live Activity updates.
Notification generation filters EventKit calendars and app-local events by selected IDs.
Widget snapshots filter selected native and app-local calendar identities.
Google download and local-to-Google upload paths have selected-calendar guards. These do not establish Microsoft or uniform cross-provider pause/resume behavior.
